name: clean generated artifacts to the allowed file set
definition: keep the intended proof files and remove any intermediate source files from the data directory
failure_mode: leftover intermediate files trip the exact-count check

name: compile a C program with embedded debug information in the emitted IR
definition: Build with debug metadata enabled so the resulting IR carries source-level variable/line debug info needed for analysis.
failure_mode: IR lacks debug records and the file is rejected

name: compute and average a per-row difference between two series
definition: For each aligned row subtract the paired values and average all differences.
failure_mode: wrong arithmetic or ordering gives a value off the ground truth

name: compute and serialize a rounded acceptance metric with fixed content
definition: turn the accepted/total fraction into a formatted decimal via a documented write and emit several artifacts
failure_mode: a formatting (width) or rounding slip breaks the artifact comparison
